gravitationalConstant.description: The non-negative proportionality constant applied to every source mass.

softeningLength.description: The positive Plummer softening length that bounds the force at short range.

attractors.description: The static sources, or empty for a field summed from bodies alone.

items.description: One gravitational source the world declares, riding a placement's authored transform.

placementId.description: The placements row whose position the source sits at. The row need not be solid or visible; only its transform is read.

items.title: WorldGravityAttractor

uniform.description: A constant acceleration added to every solved answer, in world units per second squared. Point masses cannot express a uniform field, so this is how a world keeps a flat floor underfoot while its attractors own the space around them: authored as an acceleration, it is already what a body integrates.

points.description: Ergonomic point/planet presets lowered to static masses through the same Plummer kernel as Attractors. Absent means none.

items.description: A point-gravity preset riding a placement, authored in the quantities a world designer observes.

placementId.description: The placements row at the point source's centre.

surfaceGravity.description: The positive acceleration magnitude, in world units per second squared, promised at ReferenceRadius after the world's authored softening is applied.

referenceRadius.description: The positive distance from the source centre at which SurfaceGravity is promised. For a planet this is its surface radius; a source need not carry geometry.

items.title: WorldGravityPoint

areas.description: Bounded placement-relative influences evaluated after the global solve. Absent means none.

items.description: A bounded local gravity influence riding a placement's resolved transform.

placementId.description: The placement whose position, yaw, scale, and optional body attachment the area follows.

priority.description: The deterministic composition priority. Lower values apply first; authored order breaks ties, so a later equal-priority row applies later.

mode.description: Whether the matching area's acceleration combines with or replaces the accumulated answer.
mode.title: WorldGravityAreaMode

bounds.description: The placement-relative analytic bound. Boundary points are included.

anyOf.description: A sphere centered on the riding placement.

radius.description: The positive placement-local radius, multiplied by the placement's scale.

anyOf.title: WorldGravityAreaBoundsSphereBounds

anyOf.description: A yaw-oriented box centered on the riding placement.

halfExtents.description: The positive placement-local half extents, multiplied by the placement's scale.

anyOf.title: WorldGravityAreaBoundsBoxBounds

bounds.title: WorldGravityAreaBounds

anyOf.description: A placement-local acceleration vector, rotated by the placement's resolved yaw.

value.description: The acceleration vector in world units per second squared. Zero is admitted so Replace can author a zero-gravity pocket.

anyOf.title: WorldGravityAreaAccelerationDirectional

anyOf.description: A constant-magnitude acceleration directed toward the placement origin.

magnitude.description: The positive acceleration magnitude in world units per second squared.

anyOf.title: WorldGravityAreaAccelerationRadial

items.title: WorldGravityArea

isActive.description: Gets a value indicating whether the section declares an active global or bounded local field.
